testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/pdp/verify-add-to-wishlist-functionality-on-pdp-for-retail-user.spec.ts > Webstore - PDP > verify add to wishlist functionality on pdp for retail user

scenario.summary: A registered webstore user signs in, clears the wishlist, opens a product PDP by SKU, adds it to the wishlist from the heart (tooltips and alert), checks it on the Wishlist page (count, name, sales price) and removes it again.
steps: Open the webstore home page and sign in from the header with the test's own registered account.
Search the product SKU, assert 'Showing 1 of 1 Results', open the result and check the product image.
Hover the heart ('Add to Wishlist'), click it ('Product added to your Wishlist.'), hover again ('Remove from Wishlist').
Open the Wishlist page; check the count text, product name and sales price.
Remove the first wishlist item and check the removed alert.
stateChanges: User's wishlist cleared at start, the product added, then removed (wishlist ends empty).
assertions: Search shows 'Showing 1 of 1 Results' and the product image is visible.
Tooltip 'Add to Wishlist' before and 'Remove from Wishlist' after adding; alert 'Product added to your Wishlist.'
Wishlist page shows 'Showing 1 of 1 results.', the product name and its sales price ($500.00).
Alert 'Product removed from your Wishlist.' after removal.
evidence: Title 'verify add to wishlist functionality on pdp for retail user' and step labels 1) to 5) match the flow.
Credentials are masked in the scan (profile: SENSITIVE); the test signs in with its own dedicated account, so the user need is preferred-required on the recorded username.
Profile: z-1234579 FOUND as active BundleProduct, PRODUCTION, inventory 28362, storefrontProductIndex 1, requiredAddOnCount 0: meets PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IN_STOCK.
productSalesPrice ($500.00) is the asserted wishlist price of the product; PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IN_STOCK returns price, but which price the wishlist shows for a bundle (sales vs retail) is not confirmed.
migrate: the asserted sales price ($500.00) depends on the product data, so swap is not allowed.
Spec carries a MAINTENANCE NOTE: last run 2026-09-18 failed waiting for the 'Remove from Wishlist' tooltip, not triaged (evidence only).
